captions.instagram:
Myth: if no 1099 shows up, the income doesn't count.
Fact: the IRS says to report it anyway. A 1099 is just a copy of what someone paid you. The tax is on the income, not the form.

✔️ Cash, Zelle, Venmo and app payouts count.
✔️ Self-employment tax applies once your net earnings reach $400 for the year.
✔️ Log every payment as it lands, keep the invoice with the deposit, and check your log against any 1099s you get.

captions.youtube_description: Myth: no 1099 means the income isn't taxable. Fact: the IRS says to report income even when no information return like a Form 1099-K or 1099-MISC arrives, including cash and app payments. Self-employment tax applies once net earnings reach $400. Log every payment and check it against any 1099s you receive.

sources.fact: Gig income must be reported even if not reported on an information return like Form 1099-K, 1099-MISC or W-2 (IR-2023-35); read 2026-10-24
All income, no matter the amount, is taxable unless the law says otherwise, even if you don't get a Form 1099-K; read 2026-10-24 (page updated 03-Apr-2026)
SE tax / Schedule SE applies when net earnings from self-employment are $400 or more; read 2026-10-24
